Marta — thanks for the note and the statement. We saw two incoming items in our collection feed that match the amounts you cite. Quick answers up front:

- The EUR 12,500 sweep appears as a bank-initiated credit and was applied to the open invoice batch; VAT was not recoded on that line in the posted journal and shows as a gross credit.
- The EUR 1,200 manual credit was applied as a separate adjustment and we tagged it as VAT-exempt per the credits policy you confirmed during onboarding.

That said, I agree we need to provide the bank trace so your AP can reconcile cleanly. Vanessa, can you pull the bank trace for sweep dated 2026-11-09 and include the payment advice CSV? Laura — can you double-check whether we created a single consolidated ledger entry (13,700) or two distinct posting lines in the general ledger?

I'll loop back when we have the attachments.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Manager, Account Receivables
